title: Act: Sync SceneObjects with the store and emit objectClick
summary: Wire sync and onInteract in BootScene
description: After building objects, BootScene syncs them with the store state and forwards activations to phaserToReact.
acceptance_criteria: sync runs in create and on each store change with non-null state

steps.action: After building sceneObjects, for each object call o.onInteract((e) => phaserToReact.emit('objectClick', { id: e.objectId })), then call this.onStateChange().
steps.code:
this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.onInteract((e) => phaserToReact.emit('objectClick', { id: e.objectId })));
this.onStateChange();
steps.expected: Activations reach the bus and initial sync happens

steps.action: Replace the body: const state = this.readState(); if (!state) return; this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.sync(state));
steps.expected: Null state is ignored; non-null state syncs every object
